grid.title: Grid connection
grid.description: For three-phase EV control, choose one method: an existing signed most-loaded grid-current sensor (A), or the three phase groups below. For the phase method, enable Grid Voltage R, S and T in FoxESS Modbus and pair each Grid CT R/S/T power with its matching Grid Voltage R/S/T. EPS Current R/S/T measures backup output; do not use it. Set the phase-power positive direction correctly before enabling control. If both methods are mapped, they must use the same sign convention.

tariff.title: Tariff and time windows
tariff.description: Check your provider documents carefully. Fields are ordered as meter mapping, charges, credits, allowances, user preferences, then time windows. These settings coordinate household charging and discharging to use ZEROCHARGE power, qualify for the ZEROHERO daily credit, and value boosted exports. Shoulder usage is derived automatically as every time outside the configured Peak and ZEROCHARGE windows. The exact ZEROCHARGE window is shown again before Apply.

data.free_charge_window_start: Off-peak ZEROCHARGE window start (confirm AM/PM carefully)
data.free_charge_window_end: Off-peak ZEROCHARGE window end (confirm AM/PM carefully)
data.force_discharge_finish: Force Discharge finish (normally one minute after bonus window)

data_description.daily_import_entity: METER MAPPING — Use the provider or meter's cumulative local-day import when available; otherwise HEO maintains a restart-persistent local estimate.
data_description.globird_latest_daily_cost_entity: OPTIONAL FORECAST SCORECARD — Map the GloBird integration's completed daily cost. HEO stores only its date and monetary result; this feedback can calibrate forecasts but never changes control.
data_description.globird_zerohero_status_entity: Map the GloBird integration's matching ZEROHERO result. Failed-credit days remain visible but do not train the normal successful-day cost bias.
data_description.daily_charge: CHARGES — Check your provider documents carefully and enter monetary values in dollars, not cents.
data_description.offpeak_rate_per_kwh: Pay ZERO to charge your battery: enter the usage rate inside the ZEROCHARGE allowance, normally $0.00/kWh.
data_description.shoulder_rate_per_kwh: Shoulder applies automatically at all times outside the Peak and ZEROCHARGE windows.
data_description.export_rate_per_kwh: CREDITS — Base solar/generation feed-in payment inside the configured Peak Solar/GenerationFeedin window.
data_description.offpeak_export_rate_per_kwh: Base solar/generation feed-in payment at every time outside the Peak Solar/GenerationFeedin window.
data_description.super_export_rate_per_kwh: Enter only the additional top-up above the applicable base feed-in rate. For 2 c/kWh base plus an 8 c/kWh top-up, enter 0.02 as the base rate and 0.08 here.
data_description.zerohero_daily_credit: Get paid when you use your battery instead of the grid during the ZEROHERO peak window.
data_description.daily_free_allowance_kwh: ALLOWANCES — The total ZEROCHARGE energy available to the whole site each day.
data_description.automatic_export_limit_kwh: USER PREFERENCES — The maximum energy HEO may export automatically per day. Energy and the available window determine session duration; HEO requests the inverter's maximum discharge power.
data_description.export_allowance_kwh: Only this much eligible export receives the Super Export top-up. Further export still receives its applicable Peak or Off-peak base feed-in rate.
data_description.peak_window_start: TIMES — PEAK. Shoulder is automatically every time outside the Peak and ZEROCHARGE windows.
data_description.free_charge_window_start: ZEROCHARGE — Pay zero to charge your battery. This is the $0 usage window on standard energy circuits.
data_description.bonus_window_start: ZEROHERO — Get paid when you use your battery instead of the grid. The configured daily credit requires every assessed hour to stay within the import threshold.
data_description.force_discharge_offset_minutes: Continue forced discharge this long after the ZEROHERO window ends to avoid a last-second grid import cancelling the daily credit.
data_description.export_rate_window_start: SOLAR/GENERATION FEED-IN — This pair defines the Peak feed-in period. Off-peak feed-in is automatically every other time.

data_description.ev_location_mode: Auto uses the car's location; Home or Away is a manual override.
data_description.ev_free_window_priority: During free power, give available charging capacity to the EV or home battery first.
data_description.ev_free_window_charge_limit_percent: Normal charging plans toward this car SoC. Tessie charge-limit writes are capped at 90% unless Charge to Full is on.
data_description.ev_free_window_minimum_current_a: Minimum EV current HEO tries to maintain during the free-power window.
data_description.ev_free_window_settle_minutes: Wait this long after house-battery charging begins before adjusting EV current for battery priority.
data_description.ev_house_battery_taper_soc_percent: At this home-battery SoC, battery-priority control may give more free power to the EV.
data_description.ev_direct_limit_headroom_percent: Extra car charge-limit headroom for a connected keep-alive current; it cannot bypass the 90% cap.
data_description.ev_charge_to_full_max_hours: Charge to Full turns itself off after this many hours if it has not finished sooner.
data_description.ev_charge_efficiency_percent: Estimated percentage of wall energy stored in the car battery; used for energy planning.
data_description.ev_arrival_reserve_soc_percent: Car battery margin used by the learned driving target, not the home-battery reserve.
data_description.ev_learning_minimum_samples: Number of valid driving days needed before the P85 driving estimate appears.
data_description.ev_allowance_guard_enabled: Limit free-window EV grid import to the remaining free-energy allowance. Solar can still supply the EV.
data_description.ev_allowance_safety_margin_kwh: Leave this much of the free grid-import allowance unused when planning EV charging.
data_description.ev_solar_spill_enabled: Use measured solar surplus when the home battery reaches the threshold below; this also works before free power if morning solar is off.
data_description.ev_solar_spill_battery_soc_percent: Regular solar EV charging starts only when the home battery reaches this SoC.
data_description.ev_morning_solar_enabled: Before free power, send measured solar surplus to the EV. Charging from spare home-battery energy takes over if it starts.
data_description.ev_morning_solar_reserve_soc_percent: Morning solar EV charging requires at least this home-battery SoC; separate from the regular solar threshold.
data_description.ev_pre_free_backfill_enabled: After the export period, use battery energy left after protecting house needs. HEO starts shortly before free power; the daily ready-by time does not control this.
data_description.ev_daily_backfill_energy_kwh: Protect this many wall-side kWh for the EV to receive by the ready-by time. Set 0 to disable daily ready-by charging.
data_description.ev_daily_ready_time: Time the daily energy allocation should be in the car; it must be before free power starts.
data_description.ev_outside_inverter_percent: Shared upper power limit for EV charging outside free power, before charger and grid safety limits.
data_description.ev_outside_battery_reserve_percent: At or below this home-battery SoC, stop extra EV charging outside free power. A configured keep-alive current may remain; Charge to Full is the exception.
data_description.ev_protected_baseline_a: Small current to keep a connected charger awake outside free power. Use 0 if the charger can stop and restart reliably.
data_description.ev_backfill_buffer_minutes: Start daily ready-by charging this many minutes early to allow for delays.
data_description.ev_telemetry_max_age_seconds: Reject outside-window power readings older than this when setting EV current.
data_description.ev_telemetry_max_skew_seconds: Reject power readings whose timestamps differ by more than this.
data_description.ev_before_export_enabled: Hold back automatic battery export while the EV is below the target SoC below.
data_description.ev_before_export_soc_target_percent: Car SoC below which HEO protects energy for the EV instead of automatic export.

data_description.shoulder_rate_per_kwh: Shoulder applies automatically at all times outside the Peak and ZEROCHARGE windows.
data_description.export_rate_per_kwh: CREDITS — Base solar/generation feed-in payment inside the configured Peak Solar/GenerationFeedin window.
data_description.offpeak_export_rate_per_kwh: Base solar/generation feed-in payment at every time outside the Peak Solar/GenerationFeedin window.
data_description.super_export_rate_per_kwh: Enter only the additional top-up above the applicable base feed-in rate. For 2 c/kWh base plus an 8 c/kWh top-up, enter 0.02 as the base rate and 0.08 here.
data_description.zerohero_daily_credit: Get paid when you use your battery instead of the grid during the ZEROHERO peak window.
data_description.daily_free_allowance_kwh: ALLOWANCES — The total ZEROCHARGE energy available to the whole site each day.
data_description.automatic_export_limit_kwh: USER PREFERENCES — The maximum energy HEO may export automatically per day. Energy and the available window determine session duration; HEO requests the inverter's maximum discharge power.
data_description.export_allowance_kwh: Only this much eligible export receives the Super Export top-up. Further export still receives its applicable Peak or Off-peak base feed-in rate.
data_description.peak_window_start: TIMES — PEAK. Shoulder is automatically every time outside the Peak and ZEROCHARGE windows.
data_description.free_charge_window_start: ZEROCHARGE — Pay zero to charge your battery. This is the $0 usage window on standard energy circuits.
data_description.bonus_window_start: ZEROHERO — Get paid when you use your battery instead of the grid. The configured daily credit requires every assessed hour to stay within the import threshold.
data_description.force_discharge_offset_minutes: Continue forced discharge this long after the ZEROHERO window ends to avoid a last-second grid import cancelling the daily credit.
data_description.export_rate_window_start: SOLAR/GENERATION FEED-IN — This pair defines the Peak feed-in period. Off-peak feed-in is automatically every other time.

reconfigure_solar.description: Map solar generation. Select generation-negative for a reversed FoxESS CT2.

reconfigure_house.description: Map house load and configure the ported protected-energy learning policy.

data.house_load_entity: Protected house-load sensor (optional; non-heater base load at the Working Single Phase Pilot Site)
data.house_load_includes_ev: Mapped house-load sensor includes EV charging

reconfigure_car.title: Reconfigure: Vehicle
reconfigure_car.description: Map vehicle state and presence telemetry.

data.ev_at_home_entity: EV at-home evidence entity (required when mandatory EV baseline is non-zero)
data.ev_cable_connected_entity: EV cable-connected entity (required when mandatory EV baseline is non-zero)
data.ev_lifetime_energy_entity: Tessie cumulative lifetime energy-used sensor (optional driving learning)

reconfigure_charger.title: Reconfigure: EV charger
reconfigure_charger.description: Map writable charger controls and commissioned electrical limits.

data.ev_smart_socket_entity: Smart-socket power switch (required only for smart-socket supply)
data.ev_smart_socket_current_limit_a: Commissioned smart-socket current limit (A; 0 when unused)
data.ev_smart_socket_power_switching: Allow zero-demand smart-socket power switching outside the free window
data.ev_control_commissioned: EV mappings and electrical limits commissioned

reconfigure_ev_policies.title: Reconfigure: EV charging policies
reconfigure_ev_policies.description: Set three separate ways to charge before free power: morning solar, spare home-battery energy shortly before free power, and charging by a chosen ready-by time.

data.ev_free_window_settle_minutes: Battery-charging settle time before house-priority control (minutes)
data.ev_house_battery_taper_soc_percent: House battery SoC for EV taper handoff (%)
data.ev_learning_minimum_samples: EV driving samples required for P85 learning
data.ev_allowance_guard_enabled: Keep free-window EV charging within the free-energy allowance
data.ev_solar_spill_enabled: Use surplus solar for EV when home battery is full enough
data.ev_solar_spill_battery_soc_percent: Home battery SoC to start regular solar EV charging (%)
data.ev_morning_solar_enabled: Use morning solar for EV before free power
data.ev_morning_solar_reserve_soc_percent: Home battery minimum for morning solar EV charging (%)
data.ev_pre_free_backfill_enabled: Use spare home-battery energy for EV before free power
data.ev_daily_backfill_energy_kwh: EV energy for daily ready-by charging (kWh; 0 disables)
data.ev_outside_inverter_percent: Max EV power outside free window (% of inverter output)
data.ev_telemetry_max_age_seconds: Maximum age for outside-window power telemetry (seconds)
data.ev_telemetry_max_skew_seconds: Maximum timestamp skew between outside-window power sensors (seconds)
data.ev_protected_baseline_a: EV keep-alive current outside free window (A; 0 disables keep-alive)
data.ev_outside_battery_reserve_percent: Home battery minimum for EV charging outside free window (%)
data.ev_before_export_soc_target_percent: Withhold export while EV SoC is below (%)

data_description.ev_location_mode: Auto uses the car's location; Home or Away is a manual override.
data_description.ev_free_window_priority: During free power, give available charging capacity to the EV or home battery first.
data_description.ev_free_window_charge_limit_percent: Normal charging plans toward this car SoC. Tessie charge-limit writes are capped at 90% unless Charge to Full is on.
data_description.ev_free_window_minimum_current_a: Minimum EV current HEO tries to maintain during the free-power window.
data_description.ev_free_window_settle_minutes: Wait this long after house-battery charging begins before adjusting EV current for battery priority.
data_description.ev_house_battery_taper_soc_percent: At this home-battery SoC, battery-priority control may give more free power to the EV.
data_description.ev_direct_limit_headroom_percent: Extra car charge-limit headroom for a connected keep-alive current; it cannot bypass the 90% cap.
data_description.ev_charge_to_full_max_hours: Charge to Full turns itself off after this many hours if it has not finished sooner.
data_description.ev_charge_efficiency_percent: Estimated percentage of wall energy stored in the car battery; used for energy planning.
data_description.ev_arrival_reserve_soc_percent: Car battery margin used by the learned driving target, not the home-battery reserve.
data_description.ev_learning_minimum_samples: Number of valid driving days needed before the P85 driving estimate appears.
data_description.ev_allowance_guard_enabled: Limit free-window EV grid import to the remaining free-energy allowance. Solar can still supply the EV.
data_description.ev_allowance_safety_margin_kwh: Leave this much of the free grid-import allowance unused when planning EV charging.
data_description.ev_solar_spill_enabled: Use measured solar surplus when the home battery reaches the threshold below; this also works before free power if morning solar is off.
data_description.ev_solar_spill_battery_soc_percent: Regular solar EV charging starts only when the home battery reaches this SoC.
data_description.ev_morning_solar_enabled: Before free power, send measured solar surplus to the EV. Charging from spare home-battery energy takes over if it starts.
data_description.ev_morning_solar_reserve_soc_percent: Morning solar EV charging requires at least this home-battery SoC; separate from the regular solar threshold.
data_description.ev_pre_free_backfill_enabled: After the export period, use battery energy left after protecting house needs. HEO starts shortly before free power; the daily ready-by time does not control this.
data_description.ev_daily_backfill_energy_kwh: Protect this many wall-side kWh for the EV to receive by the ready-by time. Set 0 to disable daily ready-by charging.
data_description.ev_daily_ready_time: Time the daily energy allocation should be in the car; it must be before free power starts.
data_description.ev_outside_inverter_percent: Shared upper power limit for EV charging outside free power, before charger and grid safety limits.
data_description.ev_outside_battery_reserve_percent: At or below this home-battery SoC, stop extra EV charging outside free power. A configured keep-alive current may remain; Charge to Full is the exception.
data_description.ev_protected_baseline_a: Small current to keep a connected charger awake outside free power. Use 0 if the charger can stop and restart reliably.
data_description.ev_backfill_buffer_minutes: Start daily ready-by charging this many minutes early to allow for delays.
data_description.ev_telemetry_max_age_seconds: Reject outside-window power readings older than this when setting EV current.
data_description.ev_telemetry_max_skew_seconds: Reject power readings whose timestamps differ by more than this.
data_description.ev_before_export_enabled: Hold back automatic battery export while the EV is below the target SoC below.
data_description.ev_before_export_soc_target_percent: Car SoC below which HEO protects energy for the EV instead of automatic export.

error.invalid_entity: Select a valid Home Assistant entity.
error.invalid_current_entity_unit: Select a current sensor measured in amperes. For a single-phase site, leave this blank to derive current from signed grid power and configured voltage.
error.invalid_power_entity_unit: Select a grid CT power sensor measured in W or kW.
error.invalid_voltage_entity_unit: Select a grid voltage sensor measured in V.
error.incomplete_phase_grid_mapping: Map all three grid CT phase powers and their matching grid voltages, or leave all six blank.
error.duplicate_phase_grid_mapping: Each phase must use its own distinct grid CT and grid voltage sensor. Check the highlighted phase.
error.incomplete_foxess_mapping: Map all three FoxESS control entities, or leave all three unmapped.
error.incomplete_ev_mapping: Commissioned EV control requires every Tessie telemetry and actuator mapping.
error.solar_spill_battery_power_mapping_requir: Solar-spill charging requires an explicitly mapped signed battery-power sensor.
error.outside_ev_policy_requires_local_modbus: Solar-spill and pre-free EV charging require Local Modbus to be selected as the FoxESS control owner.
error.multiphase_current_mapping_required: Commissioned multiphase EV control needs either a signed most-loaded phase current sensor (A) or all three matching grid CT power and voltage pairs.
error.invalid_ev_location_mode: Choose Auto, Home, or Away EV location policy.
error.invalid_house_occupancy_mode: Choose Auto, Home, or Away house-energy occupancy policy.
error.invalid_ev_priority: Choose house-battery or EV free-window priority.
error.invalid_ev_charge_path: Choose direct EVSE or smart socket.
error.incomplete_smart_socket_mapping: Commissioned smart-socket control requires its switch mapping and a current limit at least as high as the commissioned EV minimum.
error.invalid_site_limits: Check capacity, floor, reserve, charger, inverter, current, and voltage limits.
error.battery_capacity_required: Select a live FoxESS battery-capacity sensor, or enter a commissioned fallback capacity.
error.invalid_daily_ev_backfill: Daily EV backfill requires a commissioned inverter output/discharge limit, a non-zero outside-window percentage, and a ready time before the free-power window.
error.invalid_schedule: Choose different free-charge times and a non-negative fallback.
error.review_configuration_invalid: This configuration has a problem that needs correcting. Return to the relevant section and review its values.
error.invalid_foxess_control_owner: Choose observer only, local Modbus, or FoxCloud Mode Scheduler.
error.invalid_power_direction: Choose the direction represented by a positive sensor value.
error.incomplete_split_battery_mapping: Map both battery charge and discharge magnitude sensors, or leave both blank.
error.schedule_confirmation_required: Confirm the exact 24-hour schedule before saving.
error.overnight_confirmation_required: An overnight charging window requires the separate crossing-midnight confirmation.
error.apply_confirmation_required: Tick Apply configuration after reviewing the complete site summary.

abort.schedule_confirmation_expired: The pending schedule confirmation expired. Reopen configuration and review the times again.

options.positive_export: Positive means exporting; negative means importing

options.positive_export: Positive means exporting; negative means importing

options.positive_discharge: Positive means discharging; negative means charging

options.generation_negative: Generation is negative (for example a reversed CT2 convention)

options.local_modbus: Local Modbus (FoxCloud Mode Scheduler must be disabled)
options.foxcloud_scheduler: FoxCloud Mode Scheduler (blocks HEO Modbus writes)
